info.title: FitnessSyncer REST API
info.description: FitnessSyncer’s API provides access to information displayed within the FitnessSyncer Stream and FitnessSyncer Dashboard, including any data from data source such as Fitbit and data maintained by FitnessSyncer, such as the FitnessSyncer Notebook.

post.description:
Implements OAuth 2.0 Token Revocation (RFC 7009).
The client authenticates and sends the token to be revoked.

token_type_hint.description: Hint of the token type to optimize lookup.

200.description: Token successfully revoked, or the token was not found/already expired.

400.description: Invalid request (e.g. missing token, invalid token_type_hint, etc).

503.description: The authorization server is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Acquires the status of a historic sync
get.description:
FitnessSyncer Pro users have the ability to request historic syncs to get data in from the past for many providers, mostly those which initially we only start with a sample of the last 30 or 90 days.
You can request a Historic Sync through a Refresh.
This API will give you the current status of the historic sync status.

put.description:
This will allow you to insert new items into FitnessSyncer. You should upload data in reverse date order. It should be noted that inserting an item older than the most current item might not synchronize that item for destinations. This operation can only be done for items for which you have permission to do so.
While the permission scope indicates both notebook_write and updatable_providers are required, only the applicable one is required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: id of the source to create the item in. If this is for FitnessSyncer Notebook, this is the string `notebook`

200.description:
This will contain the itemId of the item which has been created.
Note that if the item has been filtered out, the id will be `-FILTERED-`.

post.summary: Upload a TCX, GPX, KML, KMZ, FIT, or PWX file
post.description:
If you have the data already within a file, you can upload that file into the system.
This API is just for uploading that file. To change any metadata, you will need to update that record accordingly.
Note that a single upload may result in multiple items depending on the file format.
While the permission scope indicates both notebook_write and updatable_providers are required, only the applicable one is required.

parameters.name: sourceid
parameters.description: id of the source to create the item in. If this is for FitnessSyncer Notebook, this is the string `notebook`

parameters.name: dedupe
parameters.description: True to do basic de-duping based on the filename. This is true by default.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: If you are intending this to replace an existing item, you can provide the id of the item.

requestBody.description: Multipart Form to Upload a File.

file.description: File in one of the supported file formats.

200.description:
This will contain the itemId of the item which has been created.
Note that if the item has been filtered out, the id will be `-FILTERED-`.

id.description: id of the newly uploaded item

get.description:
This method acquires the metadata descriptions from FitnessSyncer. This is highly cachable.

Authorization:
  - All types require a valid OAuth2 access token.
  - The `distinctActivities` type additionally requires the `source_data_read` scope

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Type of the data which you wish to have details for. Must be one of: activities, distinctActivities, comparisons, dataFields, goalDefaultDataFields, granularities, goalGranularities, reducers, timezones
Most of these responses are generic and are cachable between users and sessions. However, distinctActivities is the user's specific types of activities that their account has so this should not be shared between accounts.

put.summary: Accept an invitation to a Leaderboard
put.description:
This accepts an invitation to a Leaderboard.
Calling this API implies that the user has consented to this action. The user must have been shown all of the information associated with the Leaderboard and told that their information will be visibile to all users of the Leaderboard. Furthermore, for absolute data such as weight, the user should be informed *not* to share this information unless the user truly trusts the person or organization using this information.
If the invitation is already accepted, this will return a 409.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: This is the id of the Leaderboard to accept.

post.description:
Building a Chart can take time especially for users with lots of data and complex queries. To ensure that your request does not time out, this API is asynchronous.
To get data for a dashboard, you must first create a dashboard request. Next, you must poll for the results using the Get Session API.
Note that dashboard results will automatically be removed after approximately 10 minutes.
This data can be requested in an easy to consume JSON format by using the Accept Header application/json or as a CSV by using the Accept Header text/csv. Note for requests to the /dashboards/{session}, you must also include this header.

requestBody.description: What type of data do you require for your Dashboard?

200.description: In some rare occasions, the data may already be available and may be returned immediately.

schema.description: CSV representation of the Dashboard Data.

202.description: In some rare occasions, the data may already be available and may be returned immediately.

429.description: A usage rate has been exceeded.

get.summary: Checks on the status of a Dashboard Request
get.description:
After submitting a Create Dashboard Request, it will likely have responded with a 202 with a SessionCreatedResponse.
If so, you must use the session id from that response to acquire the data using this API. This may require several calls before the data is available.
Note that dashboard results will automatically be removed after approximately 10 minutes.
This data can be requested in an easy to consume JSON format by using the Accept Header application/json or as a CSV by using the Accept Header text/csv.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: This is the session id to fetch as returned by the Create Dashboard Request

200.description: This is the data associated with your Dashboard Request.

schema.description: CSV representation of the Dashboard Data.

202.description: If the data is not yet available, a 202 will be indicated.

410.description: The session is no longer valid.

OAuth2.description:
FitnessSyncer uses the standard OAuth2 Flow for authentication.

PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) is supported but not required.
Clients should use PKCE when possible for enhanced security. In our
Developer Console, you can enable the forced requirement for PKCE
for your client.

water.description: Number of Fluid Ounces of Water Consumed. This field is required if Calories is not present.

entries.description: In order to scale, we recommend grouping data per hour. These are the finer grained elements.

efficiency.description: Efficiency of the Sleep as a Percentage

inferredSleepEvents.description: If Actual Sleep Events are not available, FitnessSyncer will provide inferred Sleep Events. This is a read-only parameter.

settlingMinutes.description: Number of Minutes it took to Settle In

lightSleepMinutes.description: Number of Minutes in Light Sleep

l2SleepMinutes.description: Number of Minutes in L2 Sleep

l3SleepMinutes.description: Number of Minutes in L3 Sleep

deepSleepMinutes.description: Number of Minutes in Deep Sleep

remSleepMinutes.description: Number of Minutes in REM Sleep

hrvRmssdEvening.description: HRV RMSSD when going to Sleep

nap.description: True if this is a nap.

type.description: Sleep Stage. Must be one of: LIGHT_SLEEP, ASLEEP, AWAKE, REALLY_AWAKE, REM.

offsetMinutes.description: Minute within the sleep this started.

durationMinutes.description: Number of minutes that this event lasts for.

HistoricSyncStatus.description: This is the current status of a Historic Sync.

status.description: This is the global status of the sync, which will be either NONE or IN_PROGRESS. In particular, there is not complete status.

summary.description: This is a user-facing summary of the status.

queueTime.description: This is the time in milliseconds since the epoch when the historic sync was requested.

startPeriod.description: This is the time milliseconds since the epoch for the historic sync start period.

endPeriod.description: This is the time milliseconds since the epoch for the historic sync end period.

currentStartPeriod.description: This is the time milliseconds since the epoch of the current progressing start period.

currentEndPeriod.description: This is the time milliseconds since the epoch of the current progressing end period.

SourceData.description:
Source Data.
Note: Filters are presently not available in the API at this time.

type.description: The Type of Data this item represents. See the TaskType enumeration for the values this may have. Must be one of Activity, Allergy, Weight, BloodPressure, Cholesterol, Condition, Glucose, Medication, Nutrition, Oxygen, Sleep, Temperature

id.description: A String identifier for the task. This is used throughout the API for uniquely identifying this item.

name.description: A user description for the source.

context.description: Optional and only available in Pro accounts, provides a grouping context for our charts.

enabled.description: Indicates whether this source is enabled or not.

deprecated.description: True if this item has been deprecated.

ignoreDailyCalories.description: True to ignore the daily calories summary

lastError.description: This is a description of the last error that this source encountered.

date.description: Date of the last synchronization or error.

identifier.description: If the authentication for this is a username or identifier, this would be that string to aid in editing.

DestinationTask.description:
Destination Task
Note: Filters are presently not available in the API at this time.

type.description: This is the type of destination task. Not all of the types supported by FitnessSyncer are documented here.

id.description: A String identifier for the task. This is used throughout the API for uniquely identifying this item.

name.description: A user description for the destination.

hour.description: Hour for this task to be ran (if Pro). The time is specified in PST8PDT. Use localHour for localtime.

localHour.description: Hour converted to the user's timezone (from their profile). This can also be used to update the hour field.

lastError.description: This is a description of the last error that this source encountered.

date.description: Date of the last synchronization or error.

enabled.description: Indicates whether this destination is enabled or not.

SyncDestination.description: This is a destination which synchronizes with other sources.

taskType.description: Type of the Destination. Must be one of Activity, Allergy, Weight, BloodPressure, Cholesterol, Condition, Glucose, Medication, Nutrition, Oxygen, Sleep, Temperature

providerType.description: The Provider Type enumeration value. See Listing Providers for details.

skipDataFields.description: List of fields to skip over (if applicable)

onlyIfNotOnDest.description: Mode that only places items on the destination IF there is nothing on the destination for the day. Not recommended.

identifier.description: If the authentication for this is a username or identifier, this would be that string to aid in editing.

EmailDestination.description: This is a destination which e-mails a summary periodically.

granularity.description: What is the granularity you wish for this to run at? Must be one of: DAY, WEEK, or MONTH

dataView.description: View for the data. This is not currently used. Must be one of: STANDARD, QUARTER, HALF, YEAR

fileFormat.description: File format for attachments if the user is a Pro. Must be one of: TCX, GPX, KML, KMZ, FIT, PWX, CSV

message.description: Message to include if the user is a Pro.

otherEmail.description: Comma Delimited list of e-mail address if the user is a Pro.

AlertDestination.description: This is a destination which will alert the user of a condition

alarmType.description: The range for an alert, either n-hours ago, n-days ago, or since a specific date. Must be one of: hoursago, daysago, date

alarmArgument.description: The argument for the alert type.

reducer.description: The reducer to run on the data.

taskType.description: Type of Data to Consider. Must be one of Activity, Allergy, Weight, BloodPressure, Cholesterol, Condition, Glucose, Medication, Nutrition, Oxygen, Sleep, Temperature

field.description: The Data Field to consider for this data.

message.description: Message to include if the user is a Pro.

otherEmail.description: Comma Delimited list of e-mail address if the user is a Pro.

ShoeDestination.description: This is a special case of the Alert Task which is for reminding users to refresh shoes and service equipment.

shoes.description: The date and time that the shoes or equipment was last purchased or serviced as the number of milliseconds since the epoch in UTC.

miles.description: The number of miles or hours to fire the alert at.

renotify.description: The number of miles or hours to re-fire the alert at.

sofar.description: How many miles or hours have been logged so far (as of the last refresh).

useHoursInstead.description: Instead of using distance, use hours.

lastNotification.description: This is the last time that the user was notified about this condition. This will be 0 if it has not yet fired.

LastNotificationMiles.description: This is the value of sofar when the user was last notified.

RefreshDestination.description: A Refresh Destination is a FitnessSyncer Pro only feature which allows scheduled refreshes of all source data.

items.description: List of the TaskTypes. One of Activity, Allergy, Weight, BloodPressure, Cholesterol, Condition, Glucose, Medication, Nutrition, Oxygen, Sleep, Temperature

noticeurl.description: For items with a notice, there may be an associated web page with additional information.

appurl.description: If this represents an app, this represents the URL for that app.

Description.description: Descriptions and keys for various things within this API.

key.description: This is the key id which is to be referenced within this API.

taskType.description: If applicable, the TaskType for which this item is appropriate for. Must be one of Activity, Allergy, Weight, BloodPressure, Cholesterol, Condition, Glucose, Medication, Nutrition, Oxygen, Sleep, Temperature

defaultReducer.description: Name of the reducer that is defaulted for this data type.

isMeasuredType.description: True if this is a measured type where metric or imperial would make a difference.

metric.description: True if this value should be used on metric values. False if this is imperial. Null if this is not applicable.

onlyReportSettings.description: True if this granularity is only allowed for Report Settings and not for Report Inquiries.

postProcessed.description: True if this field requires some post processing, so may not be available within some contexts.

dataFields.description: For Scoring Fields, this is the set of DataFields that comprise this element.

measurementType.description: What type of display preference takes precedence when displaying this unit. One of: DISTANCE, WEIGHT, GLUCOSE, TEMPERATURE, NUTRITION, WATER

own.description: List of the Leaderboards this user owns.

pending.description: List of the Leaderboards this user has not yet accepted.

accepted.description: List of the Leaderboards this user has accepted.

LeaderboardUser.description: Request to add user(s) to a FitnessSyncer Leaderboard

Leaderboard.description: This is the definition of a FitnessSyncer Leaderboard

id.description: This is the unique id for this leaderboard.

name.description: This is the name of the Leaderboard. This must be unique.

granularity.description: What is the granularity you wish for this to run at? Must be one of: DAY, WEEK, or MONTH

userLimit.description: This is the user limit for this leaderboard.

email.description: Should we send periodic e-mail notifications?

anyoneCanSignUp.description: By default, the Leaderboard will only allow users who have been explicitly invited. With this option enabled, anyone with a FitnessSyncer account can sign up up-to the limit.

chartLineGranularity.description: Should the Leaderboard include the Line Chart per Granularity?

chartTableGranularity.description: Should the Leaderboard include the Table per Granularity?

chartClassicLeaderboard.description: Should the leaderboard include the Classic Leaderboard View?

relative.description: True if the graphs should be relative progress; this disables Group Goals and Classic Leaderboards. This can only be set on creation and cannot be toggled. Not applicable to scoring boards.

groupGoal.description: FitnessSyncer Leaderboards can be configured to be both a challenge for individuals or for a group. If set to a non-negative value, this setting enables group challenges and this is the value for which the primary data field must exceed. Not applicable to scoring boards.

scoringField.description: This is the scoring field type. If this is null, this is a standard metric-based leaderboard. If this is set to a value, this is a custom Leaderboard. See the Descriptions API.

scoringWeights.description: If scoringField is specified, these are the scoring weights for each of the DataFields.

dataField.description: Data Field for this Leaderboard. The first element is the primary comparison value whereas the others are used for tabular visualization.

startDate.description: Start Date of the Leaderboard in milliseconds since Epoch

endDate.description: End Date of the Leaderboard in milliseconds since Epoch

publicLeaderboard.description: True if this Leaderboard is publicly visible. If true, you can access it at https://www.fitnesssyncer.com/leaderboards?board={id} without logging in.

LeaderboardUserPreferences.description: This is the definition of a FitnessSyncer Leaderboard User Preferences

emailUpdate.description: If this is a Pro user, this will denote whether Auto-Sync is enabled or not.

categories.description: Categories of the chart, in increasing order

includeNotebook.description: Should we include the values from FitnessSyncer Notebook? The default is true.

sourceIds.description: This specifics the IDs of all of the sources to use for this query. If not specified, this will include all sources.

activityTypes.description: This specifies the sport types you wish to include. If not specified, this will include all activities. See the Descriptions Activity API.

customStart.description: If the DataView is set to PERIOD, this is the time in milliseconds to use as the start time in UTC.

customEnd.description: If the DataView is set to PERIOD, this is the time in milliseconds to use as the end time in UTC.

removeDuplicates.description: Should the chart remove duplicates? The default is true.

reducer.description: The reducer to run on the data per granularity. See the Descriptions API. The default is RANGE_NO_ZEROS.

finalReducer.description: The reducer to run on the data per period. See the Descriptions API. The default is RANGE_NO_ZEROS.

treatNoDataAsZero.description: If there is no data available for a granularity, should it be treated as a null?  The default is false.

treatZeroAsNoData.description: If a value is 0, should it be treated as a null? The default is false.

dataView.description: View for the data. Must be one of: TEN_PERIODS, STANDARD, QUARTER, HALF, or YEAR. The default is STANDARD.

granularity.description: What is the granularity you wish for this to run at? Must be one of: DAY10 (10 periods), DAY, WEEK, MONTH, or PERIOD. If PERIOD, you must set customStart and customEnd. The default is DAY10.

labeler.description: What should we use for the labeler of the data? This allows you to group the data differently; the default is PROVIDER. See the Descriptions API.

dataFields.description: Each of the DataFields for the fields to be returned. See the Descriptions API. This is a required field.

SessionCreatedResponse.description: When requesting a Dashboard, if the Dashboard takes time to build, a 201 will be returned with this object. Use the get session API to get the data.

session.description: Session id to use with the Session API

noData.description: if this is true, there is no data associated with this request.

categories.description: Categories of the chart, in increasing order

type.description: When you are using a Range reducer and there is more than one value provided, the label will be duplicated and will have a series for each of the types.

values.description: Category value for this series correlating to the category index in the global object. You will need to overlay the nulls array on this.

nulls.description: For any category value for this series which is null, there will be a true in this array. This array may not be present.

expires.description: Token expiration time in milliseconds since Epoch.
